title: antennaria parvifolia var. aureola
intro: Antennaria parvifolia var. aureola, commonly known as Golden Ragwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues such as fever, sore throats, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Golden Ragwort include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
